description: Ordered hash-chain + RFC 6962 Merkle root over a receipted population, in Journal order. Frozen by ADR_023 D1 (leaf preimage = leafHash of the 64-char hex OID STRING) and D2 (ordered RFC 6962 construction only, never sorted+deduped). All hashes are bare lowercase hex, no sha256: prefix. A reimplementation in any language reproduces every expected value from ordered_oids alone.

constants.leaf_preimage: leafHash(oid_hex) = SHA-256(0x00 || utf8(oid_hex_64)); the leaf hashes the hex STRING, NOT the raw 32 digest bytes (ADR_023 D1 / FORK-B)
constants.empty_root: SHA-256(empty) per RFC 6962 for a zero-leaf tree
constants.chain_step: head_i = SHA-256(head_{i-1} || '|' || oid_hex_i), head_0 = chain_genesis_hash, bare-hex prev

d1_negative.note: Hashing the raw 32 digest bytes instead of the hex string (the rejected FORK-B variant) produces a DIFFERENT root. The conformant root above MUST NOT equal this.

cases.name: d2_journal_order_not_sorted
cases.note: ordered_oids is in Journal (chronological) order f... then 0..., which differs from lexicographic sort. The conformant root uses this Journal order. A sorted+deduped construction (the rejected FORK-A / batch-seal variant) would reorder to 0... then f... and produce a DIFFERENT root.

d2_negative.note: Sorting the leaves ascending before building the tree produces this DIFFERENT root. The conformant root above MUST NOT equal this.

cases.name: interior_tamper_baseline
cases.note: Three leaves in Journal order. Companion to interior_tamper_mutated, which changes only the middle oid.

cases.name: interior_tamper_mutated
cases.note: The middle oid (index 1) is replaced. Both root_sha256 and head_hash MUST differ from interior_tamper_baseline, and the linear chain MUST first diverge at chain step index 1 (the tampered position).
